shared_elements: upright carved stone monument/slab with rounded top
low-relief carving on a single stone face
human or anthropomorphic figure with facial features and arms
repeated small linear signs arranged in rows
justification: Both are upright, roughly tapering stone monuments bearing relief that includes discs, horizontal dividing bands and anthropomorphic imagery, and both place the most emphatic motif in the upper zone with plainer stone below. But A is a massive three-dimensional boulder-like block whose swollen, weathered forms wrap around the body, while B is a flat thin slab with shallow, precise, flatly incised figures neatly confined within ruled rectangular registers — the manner of cutting and the compositional logic are quite different.
